gates.name: Baseline Integrity
gates.evidence: CI verified exact C4 trees, ancestor pins, 27 blob pins, pinned mathspec tree; historical replay success.

gates.name: Requirements Semantic Closure
gates.evidence: Explicit versioned registries and native trace controls; exact scope only, no arbitrary refinement or decomposition completeness.

gates.name: Metrics Semantic Closure
gates.evidence: Typed output, native comparison, assertion, method composition controls; same-slot numerical dependency; broad negative diagnostic tests; quantitative scope limited.

gates.name: System Test Semantic Closure
gates.evidence: Three reusable methods, finite support, inherited input/precondition bindings; no independently executable external oracles or broader test method contracts.

gates.name: Evidence & Assessment Closure
gates.evidence: Native computed receipts, claims and applicability tested; external review/authenticity not established; trace aggregation bounded.

gates.name: Native Mathematical Integrity
gates.evidence: C4 native Program authority unchanged; no competing AST; pinned upstream mathspec 4140 pass, 47 skipped.

gates.name: Canonical Integration
gates.evidence: Within admitted C5 structural fragment, native A/B roundtrip, pins, recomputed receipt and versioned identities observed; no general semantic equivalence.

gates.name: Minimality & Reuse
gates.evidence: Five ablations; no matched-scope alternate implementation or global minimality proof.

gates.name: Maintainability & Migration
gates.evidence: Controlled edits, method exchange and explicit migration; not all 9 experiments independently measured; no independent human authoring.

gates.name: Native Regression
gates.evidence: 20 grouped C5 test methods passed; historical replay succeeded on earlier C5 commit. Latest combined exact-tree workflow exit not established at recording time.

gates.name: Integrated CBA Reference Demonstration
gates.evidence: Nine positive/negative/incomplete cases each executed A/B, exact canonical match, native receipts and evidence; synthetic not full CBA.

gates.name: Final Specification
gates.evidence: Consolidated candidate specification, grammar, metamodel, structural schema and limits; consistency not fully demonstrated and candidate not final release.

gates.name: Critical Scientific Review
gates.evidence: Separate critical review and risk register; AI internal not person-independent audit; residual material gaps.

limitations: No scope reduction used to mark partially satisfied material gates MET.
